rows.en: (...I'm hungry. Maybe I'll go buy a late-night snack.)

\p...
What are you doing out this late at night?

Yamashiro-sensei!
What are you doing out at this hour, Sensei?
I'm on my way home from a drinking party.

...With Gary-sensei and the others?
You don't look drunk, though.
Of course not. I didn't drink.
If I got drunk too, who would look after that lot?
...They're that bad...?

It's hardly something fit for anyone to see...
Now then, hurry home and get to bed.

(...I wonder what Gary-sensei and the others'
drinking parties are like.)
(...This area got pretty wrecked too, huh...)

\p.
This area's supposed to be off-limits.

Y-Yamashiro-sensei!
What are you doing here yourself, Sensei?

I was asked to carry out a survey.
I'm here on duty.

But with this much destruction,
rebuilding the fleet will be difficult...
What do you mean by that...?

...It means the time left to the Frontier fleet
is very short.
Time left...

Now, enough idle talk.
For now, go home and get some proper rest.
(...What's going to happen to Frontier...?)
(...This area got pretty badly wrecked too...)
(Tests are finally over~)

What's the matter,
\p?

Yamashiro-sensei...
Now that tests are over, I just feel all drained...

I suppose you tried to scrape by
with an all-night cram session?
Gulp!

Knowledge thrown together in a rush is useless
when you really need it. Do you understand that?

When your tests are returned, try solving them again.
You'll see just how little has actually sunk in.

(Yamashiro-sensei sure is strict
when it comes to studying...)

(I'll just have cup ramen for dinner.
Cooking's such a hassle, after all.)

\p.
Heading home now?
Yes. I bought cup ramen, so that's my dinner.
...What?
Is something wrong, Sensei?
You eat that kind of unhealthy stuff?

It's fine, the noodles aren't fried.
And it's the kind with lots of veggies.

Honestly, you're still young.
Why not learn to cook at least one dish?
What about you, Sensei?

However tired I am when I get home,
I make my own meals.

In any case, you mustn't eat only that sort of thing.
Understood?
Y-yes! I'll be careful from now on!!
(Maybe I'll try learning to cook...)

(Cup ramen for dinner should be fine, right?
Cooking's such a hassle, after all.)
Ehehe... What about you, Sensei?
(Crap, I headed to the wrong classroom...!)
Whoa...
rows.notes: x4: also Kagura in nml_kgr_008 (same collision scene).

rows.en: S-sorry, Yamashiro-sensei!
Are you all right yourself?

Yes, thanks to you.
Ah, your glasses...
rows.notes: Whose glasses is unstated; the next player monologue (first time seeing his bare face) settles it as Yamashiro's.

rows.en:
Hm... No problem.
Don't run in the halls.

(...That's the first time I've seen
Yamashiro-sensei without his glasses.)
(Yikes, I headed to the wrong classroom...!)
Kyaah!
rows.notes: x4: female collision yelp, also nml_kgr_008, nml_myk_008, nml_rnk_008.

rows.en: (Lunch break is here! What should I eat?)
Yamashiro-sensei, are you having lunch?
Yes, that's right.
What are you going to eat?

There's a place nearby that serves grilled fish,
so I plan to go there.

That sounds great!
I want some too!

Not you.
It takes at least 30 minutes for the food to come out.
Lunch break would be about over by then...

Exactly.
Be a good student and go to the school store.
(Aww, too bad!)

That sounds great!
I want to eat there too!

Not you.
It's a place where the food takes at least 30 minutes.
